description: This file contains unit tests for the BookUtils class, specifically testing the combineTitleAndSeries method with different scenarios involving the book's series position.

classes.name: BookUtilsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of BookUtils methods, especially combineTitleAndSeries.

methods.name: BookUtilsTest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test class with a Book instance using a PredefinedShelfService.

methods.name: notShowSeriesPositionIfBookIsNotInSeries

methods.name: returnTitleWhenSeriesPositionIsZero
methods.description: Test that verifies the method returns only the title when the series position is zero.

methods.name: showSeriesPositionCorrectly
methods.description: Test that verifies the method appends the series position correctly when it is a positive number.
